notes: TOU periods per 湖北省发改委《关于完善工商业分时电价机制有关事项的通知》鄂发改价管〔2024〕77号 (2024-03-27, effective 2024-05-01; cited by the notices): 尖峰 7、8月 20-22, other months 18-20; 高峰 7、8月 16-20、22-24, other months 16-18、20-24; 平 6-12、14-16; 谷 0-6、12-14 (尖峰 applies in every month).

Holiday 深谷 per 鄂发改价管〔2025〕86号 (effective 2025-05-01): during 春节、劳动节、国庆节 (dates as announced by the State Council) 9:00-15:00 is 深谷 (float 0.9 for 9-12 & 14-15, 0.43 for 12-14); stored as a separate day_type='holiday' rule for months 1, 2, 5, 10.  The monthly notices print no 深谷 price, so deep_valley is NULL.

Float: 尖峰:高峰:平:谷 = 1.8 : 1.49 : 1 : 0.48 in ordinary months, 尖峰 2 and 谷 0.45 in 7、8、12、1月, applied to 代理购电价格 + 上网环节线损 (系统运行费、基金、输配电价 do not float), so the TOU spread is identical on every voltage row.

Source: 95598.cn static image PDFs (网上国网 › 执行的电价和收费标准, region 湖北): combined 2025年1-12月 (pages 1-2 used) and 2026年1-6月 notices, monthly from 2026-07. OCR'd with tesseract, cross-validated against the notice arithmetic; repairs logged.
